{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    if not pts:return [row[:] for row in grid]

    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]

        k=r-r0

        seq=[1,0,-1,0] if height%2==0 else [0,1,0,-1]
        nc=c+seq[k%4]
        if 0<=nc<w: out[r][nc]=grid[r][c]

    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0]); cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]]

    lo=min(x[0] for x in cells); hi=max(x[0] for x in cells)
    # The horizontal displacement is a four-row wave anchored at the object's top.
    phase = 1 if (hi-lo+1)%2==0 else 0
    ans=[[0 for _ in range(W)] for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        t=(r-lo)%4
        delta = phase-t if False else ([1,0,-1,0] if phase else [0,1,0,-1])[t]
        ans[r][c+delta]=v
    return ans"}
